lines_route_bodyschema: Zod schema validating the body of POST /api/orders/[id]/lines with productId, optional techniqueId, notes, sizeQuantities and quantity.
lines_route_editable: List of order statuses (borrador, presupuesto_enviado, aprobado) in which order lines can still be added.
lines_route_post: Handles POST /api/orders/[id]/lines by validating the payload, checking the order is still editable, and creating the line with its per-size items.
stage_route_productive: Constant listing the productive workshop stages used to validate stage transitions.
stage_route_stage_to_event: Constant mapping each order stage to the production event it emits.
orders_route: API route under /api/orders that reads and creates orders.
orders_route_post: Handles POST /api/orders by requiring notes, generating a public token and inserting a new order.
organizations_route: API route under /api/organizations that reads and creates client organizations.
organizations_route_post: Handles POST /api/organizations by validating the payload with organizationSchema and inserting a new organization row.
payments_route: API route under /api/payments that registers and cancels payments for authenticated users inside a database transaction.
payments_route_post: API route handler that registers a payment through an HTTP POST request.
pricing_rules_route: API route under /api/pricing-rules that reads and creates pricing rules.
pricing_rules_route_post: API route handler that creates a pricing rule through an HTTP POST request.
sizes_route: API route under /api/products/[id]/sizes that reads and writes the sizes of a product.
sizes_route_post: API route handler that creates sizes for a product through an HTTP POST request.
products_route: API route under /api/products that reads and creates products.
products_route_post: API route handler that creates a product through an HTTP POST request.
token_route: Public API route under /api/public/order/[token] that returns an order's data by its tracking token.
token_route_get: API route handler that returns public tracking data for an order token through an HTTP GET request.
items_route: API route under /api/recipes/[id]/items that reads and writes the BOM items of a recipe.
items_route_post: Handles POST /api/recipes/[id]/items by verifying the recipe and material exist and adding a BOM item to the recipe.
itemid_route: API route handler that deletes a BOM item by id after requiring an authenticated user.
itemid_route_delete: Handles DELETE /api/recipes/items/[itemId] by deleting the BOM item and returning 404 when nothing was deleted.
recipes_route: API route under /api/recipes that reads and creates BOM recipes for products.
recipes_route_post: API route handler that creates a recipe through an HTTP POST request.
techniques_route: API route under /api/techniques that reads and creates application techniques.
techniques_route_post: API route handler that creates an application technique through an HTTP POST request.
app_layout: Root layout that sets the document language to Spanish, loads the Inter and Space Grotesk fonts and renders children in the body.
app_layout_metadata: Root metadata for the application, setting the site title and description.
app_layout_rootlayout: Root layout that renders the html and body elements with the project fonts.
login_loginform: File defining LoginForm, the client component that posts email and password to the login API and redirects to the admin panel on success.
login_loginform_loginform: Client login form that posts email and password to /api/auth/login and redirects to the admin panel on success.
login_page: Server component login page that redirects already-authenticated users to the admin panel and otherwise renders the login form.
login_page_loginpage: Async login page component that redirects authenticated users to /admin and otherwise renders the login form.
app_page: Public landing page that presents the workshop platform and links to the quote wizard and the internal login.
app_page_publiclanding: Public landing page that introduces the workshop and links to the quote wizard and login.
ui_button: UI module exporting the Button component used across admin and public forms.
ui_button_variant: Type of the allowed Button variant values.
ui_button_size: Type of the allowed Button size values.
ui_button_variants: Map from each Button variant to its Tailwind CSS classes.
ui_button_sizes: Map from each Button size to its Tailwind CSS classes.
ui_button_button: Button component that renders a styled button element with variant and size props.
ui_button_linkbutton: LinkButton component that renders a Next.js link styled as a button.
ui_card: UI module exporting the Card layout primitives used to frame admin page content.
ui_card_tone: Type of the allowed Card tone values.
ui_card_tones: Map from each Card tone to its Tailwind CSS classes.
ui_card_badge: Badge component that renders a small status pill with color variants.
ui_card_card: Card component that renders a bordered surface container with an optional title.
ui_card_statcard: Shared UI component that renders a labelled KPI tile with a value, an optional delta and an optional icon.
ui_card_pageheader: PageHeader component that renders a page title with optional description and actions.
ui_card_emptystate: Shared UI component that renders a centered panel with a title, optional description and optional action for empty lists.

ui_input_textarea: Shared UI component that renders a styled multiline textarea input.
ui_input_select: Select component that renders a styled dropdown bound to a form field.
ui_input_label: UI component that renders a styled form label.
ui_input_field: Field component that renders a labelled form field wrapper around its control.
ui_table: UI module exporting the table primitives Table, THead, TH, TR and TD used in admin listings.
ui_table_table: Table component that renders a styled table element with its wrapper.
ui_table_thead: THead component that renders a table header section.
ui_table_th: TH component that renders a table header cell.
ui_table_tr: TR component that renders a table row.
ui_table_td: TD component that renders a table body cell.
db_client: Database client module that builds the Neon HTTP driver connection used by the application.
db_client_sql: The Neon serverless HTTP SQL client created from DATABASE_URL and passed to Drizzle in src/db/client.ts.
db_client_db: The exported Drizzle database instance created in src/db/client.ts and used for all queries.
migrations_0001_public_upload_sessions: Idempotent SQL migration that creates the upload_sessions table with its enum and index and adds upload session and expiry columns to attachments.

db_schema: Drizzle ORM schema module defining every database table and column of the AH Sports OS Postgres database.
db_schema_userrole: Postgres enum user_role listing the system roles admin, disenador, operario and gerencia.
db_schema_orderstatus: Postgres enum order_status covering the order lifecycle from borrador through the production stages to entregado, cancelado and bloqueado_pago.
db_schema_productionstage: Postgres enum production_stage with the per-garment stages ingreso, corte, confeccion, estampado, control and entrega.
db_schema_paymentmethod: Postgres enum payment_method listing the accepted payment methods: efectivo, transferencia, cheque, mercadopago and otro.
db_schema_paymentkind: Postgres enum payment_kind distinguishing a sena, a pago and a saldo.
db_schema_paymenteventtype: Postgres enum payment_event_type holding the audit values registered and cancelled.
db_schema_attachmentkind: Postgres enum attachment_kind classifying attachments as identidad_organizacion, sponsor, diseno_pedido, personalizacion_individual, documento_operativo or produccion_calidad.
db_schema_attachmentstatus: Postgres enum attachment_status for attachment review states: pendiente_revision, aprobado, requiere_reemplazo, rechazado and archivado.
db_schema_uploadsessionstatus: Postgres enum upload_session_status with the values active, consumed and expired.
db_schema_applicationview: Postgres enum application_view listing where an artwork application sits on a garment: frente, espalda, lateral, manga or otro.
db_schema_organizationkind: Postgres enum organization_kind listing client types: club, empresa, colegio, institucion and particular.
db_schema_leadstatus: Postgres enum lead_status for the contact pipeline stages: nuevo, contactado, calificado, convertido and perdido.
db_schema_materialunit: Postgres enum material_unit listing material measurement units: metro, kilo, unidad, centimetro, mililitro, metro_cuadrado and rollo.
db_schema_users: Drizzle table definition for users, holding staff email, password hash, role and active flag.
db_schema_sessions: Drizzle table storing server-side authentication sessions with user reference and expiry.
db_schema_organizations: Drizzle table definition for the organizations table, storing the client organizations such as clubs, companies and schools.
db_schema_contacts: Drizzle table definition for the contacts table, storing the contact people of each client organization.
db_schema_materials: Drizzle table definition for the materials table, storing the workshop materials with their unit of measure and cost.
db_schema_techniques: Drizzle table definition for the techniques table, storing the application techniques such as sublimation, DTF and embroidery.
db_schema_products: Drizzle table definition for the products table, holding the garment catalog offered by the workshop.
db_schema_sizes: Drizzle table definition for the sizes table, storing the per-product size list with its measurements.
db_schema_bomrecipes: Drizzle table definition for the bom_recipes table, linking a product to its bill-of-materials recipe.
db_schema_bomitems: Drizzle table definition for bom_items, the rows linking a BOM recipe to a material with a quantity and a waste percentage.
db_schema_pricingrules: Drizzle table definition for the pricing rules table, storing the quantity thresholds and their price effects.
db_schema_orders: Drizzle table definition for the orders table, storing each client order with its status and quoted snapshot.
db_schema_pricingsnapshot: TypeScript type describing the frozen pricing snapshot stored on an order: rule, per-line costs and materials, totals and generation timestamp.
db_schema_snapshothistoryentry: Type describing a superseded pricing snapshot together with the timestamp and reason (re-quote or confirm) that replaced it.
db_schema_orderlines: Drizzle table definition for the order lines table, grouping the garments of an order by product and size breakdown.
db_schema_orderitems: Drizzle table definition for the order items table, storing each garment of a line with its size, name and production stage.
db_schema_uploadsessions: Drizzle table definition for upload_sessions, which stores the hash of a browser upload secret along with its status and expiry.
db_schema_attachments: Drizzle table definition for the attachments table, storing the uploaded artwork files with their kind and status.
db_schema_applications: Drizzle table definition for the applications table, which records an artwork attachment applied to a zone, view and technique on a garment.
db_schema_payments: Drizzle table definition for the payments table, storing order payments with kind, method, amount and soft-cancellation columns.
db_schema_paymentevents: Drizzle table for the insert-only audit trail of payment lifecycle events (registered or cancelled).
db_schema_productionevents: Drizzle table definition for production_events, the append-only log of production stage changes per order or order item.
db_schema_settings: Drizzle table definition for settings, a key/value store with a JSONB value and an update timestamp.
db_schema_organizationsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking an organization to its contacts, orders and attachments.
db_schema_contactsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking a contact to its organization.
db_schema_ordersrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking an order to its organization, contact, lines, attachments, payments and production events.
db_schema_orderlinesrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking an order line to its order, product, technique and items.
db_schema_productsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking a product to its sizes, BOM recipes and order lines.
db_schema_bomrecipesrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking each BOM recipe to its product, size, technique and items.
db_schema_bomitemsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking each BOM item to its recipe and material.
db_schema_attachmentsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking an attachment to its order, organization, upload session and applications.
db_schema_uploadsessionsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking an upload session to the attachments staged in it.
db_schema_paymentsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking a payment to its order and its payment events.
db_schema_paymenteventsrelations: Drizzle relations definition linking each payment event to its payment and its order.
db_seed: Seed script that inserts the initial admin user, demo organization, products, materials and pricing rules.
db_seed_hashpasswordseed: Hashes a password with scrypt into the salt:hash format used by the seed script without importing the Next-only auth module.
db_seed_getadminpassword: Reads ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment and throws when it is missing or shorter than eight characters.
db_seed_adminpassword: The admin password resolved at seed time from the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable and used to create the seed admin user.
db_seed_main: Entry point of the seed script that truncates all tables and inserts the admin user, demo organization and catalog data.
lib_auth: Authentication module implementing password hashing plus the signed session cookie helpers.
lib_auth_hashpassword: Hashes a password with scrypt and a random 16-byte salt, returning the salt:hash string stored in users.password_hash.
lib_auth_verifypassword: Verifies a plaintext password against a stored salt:hash value using scrypt and a timing-safe comparison.
lib_auth_sign: Computes the HMAC-SHA256 hex signature of a value using the SESSION_SECRET environment variable.
lib_auth_verifysignature: Recomputes a value signature and compares it to the supplied one in constant time.
lib_auth_createsession: Creates a session row, signs its id with HMAC-SHA256 and sets the httpOnly session cookie with a seven-day expiry.
lib_auth_destroysession: Deletes the current session row from the database and clears the session cookie.
lib_auth_getcurrentuser: Reads the session cookie, verifies its HMAC signature and returns the matching non-expired user or null.
lib_auth_requireuser: Reads the session cookie and returns the authenticated user, redirecting to login when no valid session exists.
lib_auth_requirerole: Returns the current user when their role is in the allowed list and otherwise redirects to the admin dashboard.
lib_auth_quickhash: Returns the first 16 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 hash of a value.
lib_db_transaction: Module exporting withDbTransaction, which runs a callback inside a database transaction.
lib_db_transaction_transactiondb: Drizzle instance built on a Neon Pool that supports transactions for dependent writes.
lib_db_transaction_transaction: Type extracted from the Neon Pool Drizzle instance that represents the callback transaction handle.
lib_db_transaction_dbtransaction: Type alias for the Drizzle transaction type used by the transaction helper.
lib_db_transaction_withdbtransaction: Runs a callback inside a Drizzle transaction on the Neon serverless pool driver and exposes the transaction handle as DbTransaction.
lib_payments: Payment domain module providing cent conversion, required advance calculation, block-status recalculation and transactional payment registration and cancellation.
lib_payments_tocents: Converts a decimal money string or number into integer cents and throws when the format is not a valid decimal.
lib_payments_fromcents: Converts integer cents back into a two-decimal string suitable for numeric columns.
lib_payments_sumactivepaymentscents: Sums the amounts of non-cancelled payments and returns the total in integer cents.
lib_payments_requiredadvancecents: Calculates the required deposit in cents as the quoted total multiplied by the minimum advance percentage, rounded up.
lib_payments_unblock_from: List of order statuses that are moved to aprobado once the deposit requirement is met.
lib_payments_reblock_from: List of order statuses that are moved to bloqueado_pago when the deposit requirement is no longer met.
lib_payments_frozen_status: List of production and terminal order statuses that the deposit block gate never transitions.
lib_payments_blockgateinput: Type describing the deposit block gate inputs: order status, totalQuoted, minAdvancePercent and activeTotalCents.
lib_payments_blockgateresult: Type describing the deposit block gate result: the resulting status and whether it changed.
lib_payments_recalculateblockstatus: Computes the next order status from the quoted total, minimum advance percentage and active payments, moving only between bloqueado_pago and pre-production states.
lib_payments_paymentinput: Type describing a payment registration input: orderId, kind, method, amount, reference, notes and createdById.
lib_payments_paymentdomainerror: Custom error class used by the payments service to signal domain failures such as a missing order or an already-cancelled payment.
lib_payments_ordergaterow: Internal type for the order row loaded by the payment gate: id, status, totalQuoted and minAdvancePercent.
lib_payments_loadordergate: Loads an order status, quoted total and minimum advance percentage, preferring the value frozen in the pricing snapshot.
lib_payments_registerpaymenttx: Transaction-scoped function that inserts a payment, appends its audit event and recalculates the order payment block status.
lib_payments_cancelpaymenttx: Transaction-scoped function that soft-cancels a payment, records a cancellation audit event and recalculates the order payment block status.
lib_payments_getorderfinancials: Returns quoted, paid and balance amounts in cents plus payment counts for an order, excluding cancelled payments.
lib_pricing: Pricing module that quotes order lines from the BOM recipes, pricing rules and techniques, and lists the related catalog rows.
lib_pricing_quotelineinput: Type describing one quote line input: productId, quantity and optional sizeId, techniqueId and overrideUnitPrice.
lib_pricing_quoteresult: Type describing a quote result: priced lines with their materials, totals, the applied rule and the pricing snapshot.
lib_pricing_quoteorder: Calculates order line costs and prices from products, BOM recipes, materials and techniques using the active or supplied pricing rule and returns totals plus a frozen snapshot.
lib_pricing_round2: Rounds a number to two decimal places for pricing calculations.
lib_pricing_round3: Rounds a number to three decimal places.
lib_pricing_listsizesforproduct: Lists the sizes defined for a given product id.
lib_pricing_listtechniques: Lists all active application techniques from the database.
lib_pricing_listmaterials: Lists all active materials from the database.
lib_pricing_listproducts: Lists all active products from the database.
lib_pricing_getorderline: Loads a single order line row by id from the database.
lib_pricing_roundto: Rounds a number up to the nearest multiple, returning it unchanged when the multiple is not positive.
lib_public_upload_sessions: Module that creates, verifies and expires the short-lived sessions that authorise public attachment uploads.
lib_public_upload_sessions_publicuploads: Type describing a public upload session handle: id, opaque secret and ISO expiry timestamp.
lib_public_upload_sessions_hashsecret: Hashes an upload secret with SHA-256 to produce the value stored as the session secret hash.
lib_public_upload_sessions_matchespublic: Compares a supplied upload secret against the stored SHA-256 hash using a constant-time comparison.
lib_public_upload_sessions_createpublicu: Creates a two-hour upload session row that stores only the secret hash and returns the session id, secret and expiry.
lib_public_upload_sessions_getlivepublic: Looks up an active, non-expired upload session and verifies its secret before returning it.
lib_public_upload_sessions_cleanupexpire: Deletes expired public upload sessions and their staged attachments, retaining rows whose backing object could not be deleted for a later retry.
lib_storage: Storage module that validates uploaded files, sanitises file names and resolves the active local or S3 storage adapter.
lib_storage_allowed_mimes: Read-only list of MIME types accepted for attachment uploads, covering PNG, JPEG, SVG, WebP, PDF, PostScript, Illustrator and Photoshop files.
lib_storage_allowedmime: Union type of the MIME type strings contained in ALLOWED_MIMES.
lib_storage_storageadapter: Interface defining the pluggable storage contract with upload and delete methods.
lib_storage_filelike: Type describing the minimal file shape validated on upload: optional type, size and name.
lib_storage_validatefile: Checks that an uploaded file MIME type is whitelisted and that its size does not exceed 5 MB.
lib_storage_sanitizefilename: Sanitizes an uploaded file name into a safe lowercase basename limited to allowed characters.
lib_storage_buildattachmentpath: Builds a randomized storage-relative path for an attachment, scoped by order id or pending and sanitizing the original file name.
lib_storage_assertsafepath: Throws when a relative storage path is empty, absolute, or contains parent-directory segments or backslashes.
lib_storage_uploads_dir: Absolute path to the public/uploads directory used by the local storage adapter.
lib_storage_localstorageadapter: Storage adapter that writes uploads under public/uploads with MIME, size and path-traversal validation, and deletes them by URL.
lib_storage_s3storageadapter: Placeholder storage adapter whose upload and delete methods throw until the S3 implementation lands in F5.
lib_utils: Shared utility module providing class-name merging and formatting helpers for currency, percent and dates.
lib_utils_cn: Merges clsx class values with tailwind-merge to resolve conflicting Tailwind classes.
lib_utils_formatcurrency: Formats a numeric value as an Argentine peso currency string.
lib_utils_formatpercent: Formats a number or numeric string as a percentage with one decimal place and returns a dash for invalid input.
lib_utils_formatdate: Formats a date or date string as day, month and year in the es-AR locale and returns a dash for empty input.
lib_utils_formatdatetime: Formats a date or date string with day, month, year, hour and minute in the es-AR locale and returns a dash for empty input.
lib_utils_generatepublictoken: Generates a 16-character random alphanumeric token used as an order public tracking token.
lib_validators: Zod validation module exposing the schemas that validate server action and API inputs.
lib_validators_materialschema: Zod schema validating material fields such as name, category, unit, unit price and yield percent.
lib_validators_techniqueschema: Zod schema validating a technique name, per-unit cost, per-square-meter cost, setup cost and description.
lib_validators_pricingruleschema: Zod schema validating a pricing rule margin, urgent surcharge, minimum advance percentage, rounding and active flag.
lib_validators_productschema: Zod schema validating product SKU, name, base price, minimum order and allowed zones.
lib_validators_sizesbatchschema: Zod schema validating a batch of product sizes with label, order and measurement values.
lib_validators_recipeschema: Zod schema validating a bill-of-materials recipe header with product, optional size and optional technique.
lib_validators_recipeitemschema: Zod schema validating a bill-of-materials recipe item with material id, quantity and waste percent.
lib_validators_organizationkindschema: Zod enum schema for the organization kinds club, empresa, colegio, institucion and particular.
lib_validators_organizationschema: Zod schema validating organization name, kind, tax id and notes.
lib_validators_contactschema: Zod schema validating contact fields such as name, email, phone, role and lead status.
lib_validators_organizationwithcontactsc: Zod schema validating creation of an organization together with its contact.
lib_validators_orderstatusschema: Zod enum schema for the twelve order statuses from borrador to bloqueado_pago.
lib_validators_orderschema: Zod schema validating order creation with organization, contact, status, urgency, notes and pricing rule.
lib_validators_orderlineschema: Zod schema validating an order line: orderId, productId, optional techniqueId and recipeId, quantity, unitPrice, unitCost and notes.
lib_validators_createorderlineschema: Zod schema validating order line creation with per-size quantities or a total quantity, requiring at least one of them.
lib_validators_orderitempatchschema: Zod schema validating a partial update of an order item's individual name, number or stage, requiring at least one change.
lib_validators_orderitemstageschema: Zod schema validating a single order item production stage value.
lib_validators_stageschema: Zod schema validating an order-level production stage value.
lib_validators_confirmquoteschema: Zod schema validating the order id and optional pricing rule id used when confirming a quote.
lib_validators_requoteorderschema: Zod schema validating a re-quote request with the order id and an urgent flag.
lib_validators_attachmentkindschema: Zod enum schema listing the allowed attachment kinds, from organization identity to production quality.
lib_validators_attachmentstatusschema: Zod enum of the allowed attachment review statuses.
lib_validators_applicationviewschema: Zod enum schema for the application view values frente, espalda, lateral, manga and otro.
lib_validators_paymentkindschema: Zod enum of the allowed payment kinds: sena, pago and saldo.
lib_validators_paymentmethodschema: Zod enum of the allowed payment methods: efectivo, transferencia, cheque, mercadopago and otro.
lib_validators_registerpaymentschema: Zod schema validating a payment registration payload with order id, kind, method, positive amount and optional reference and notes.
lib_validators_cancelpaymentschema: Zod schema validating the payment id used to cancel a payment.
lib_validators_attachmentuploadschema: Zod schema validating an attachment upload with a kind plus at least one of orderId or organizationId.
lib_validators_attachmentpatchschema: Zod schema validating partial updates to an attachment's status, notes or name, requiring at least one change.
lib_validators_applicationschema: Zod schema validating an artwork application: attachmentId, optional orderLineId, zone, view, optional techniqueId, dimensions, quantity and instructions.
lib_validators_applicationinputschema: Zod schema for creating an application through the API, derived from applicationSchema with attachmentId removed because it comes from the URL.
lib_validators_copyattachmentschema: Zod schema validating the attachment id and destination order id used when copying an attachment.
lib_validators_createpublicorderschema: Zod schema validating the public wizard order payload including contact data, size quantities, individual items and upload session credentials.
lib_validators_publicattachmentuploadsch: Zod schema validating the metadata of a public pre-order attachment upload (kind plus upload session credentials).
lib_validators_isuniqueviolation: Walks an error cause chain looking for the PostgreSQL unique violation code 23505 or a unique/duplicate message.
